title: ClientConfig zero-value limits are silently accepted
description: ClientConfig fields are pub u64 with no validation in JmapClient::new(). A caller who writes max_call_body: 0 gets a client that returns ResponseTooLarge on every non-empty API response. The error message 'response too large: N bytes exceeds limit of 0 bytes' is confusing without knowing the misconfigured limit. Zero timeouts (Duration::ZERO) pass silently too. No validation at construction means bugs surface far from their cause.
